items.text: To wrap up our two-day tour focused on increasing food security and access to nutrition in Massachusetts, we spoke with @TuftsNutrition and community leaders about what Congress can do to reinforce the work being done locally across the country to #EndHunger nationwide. https://t.co/ZML4KX3RO5
Having lost my own father to suicide nearly 33 years ago, ensuring access to behavioral health treatment is personal to me.
Had a wonderful time visiting Pittsburg’s Senior Health & Resources Fair where seniors could receive free health screenings, exercise demonstrations, and more. https://t.co/zBIDjM0fW4
I'm proud to lead the effort to advance legislation to meet the need for mental health care & substance abuse treatment for students, workers, & families.

To fight food insecurity, the Biden Administration is hosting a White House Conference on Nutrition for the first time in 50 years. Ahead of the conference, the White House is holding regional listening sessions. https://t.co/NzoY18PvjF
To participate or share your experience with hunger or diet-related diseases, visit https://t.co/NzoY18PvjF

As a cancer survivor, I know first-hand the challenges survivors face following their diagnosis. On #NationalCancerSurvivorsDay & every day, I will continue working on the bipartisan Congressional Cancer Survivors Caucus for improved quality of life for survivors. #NCSD2022 https://t.co/ZFk4feh2v0

As we mark National Cancer Survivor's Day, I’m continuing my bipartisan work as founder & co-chair of the Congressional Cancer Survivors Caucus with @RepBuddyCarter to ensure better access to care for millions of survivors suffering from the effects of their cancer treatment.

.@WhiteHouse has announced an additional regional listening session June 15th from 3 – 5 p.m. EDT in advance of its Conference on Nutrition. If you’re interested in listening or sharing your experience with hunger or diet-related diseases, please visit https://t.co/NzoY18PvjF.

Isabel Bueso came to the U.S. to receive life-saving treatment not available in her home country. When the Trump Admin. cancelled deferred action, we helped ensure she would be able to stay in Concord and receive care, but she needs a permanent solution. https://t.co/dYTbYJ9Osd

We also talked about two highlights of the week – honoring Betty Reid Soskin on the House Floor and passing a bill through the House that would allow Concord resident, Isabel Bueso, to continue living in the U.S. to receive life-saving treatment!
As a cancer survivor and as founder and co-chair of the Congressional Cancer Survivors Caucus, expanding patient access to quality care and treatment is a top priority for me. https://t.co/eRoHgCS9kD

Yesterday, I tested positive for COVID-19. I am feeling great and have only experienced mild symptoms. In accordance with CDC guidelines, I will be isolating and working remotely from my home including voting by proxy. I continue to encourage everyone to get vaccinated & boosted. https://t.co/bt0jXch8wo

As a cancer survivor, I know just how daunting the diagnosis & the treatment process can be. I’m proud to again introduce legislation with @RepBuddyCarter to support cancer patients with emotional and logistical assistance services. @canceradvocacy @NCCN @ACSCAN

As a cancer survivor, I know how daunting it can be to navigate treatment. I’m proud to lead this effort with @RepDWStweets to ensure survivors and their families have the resources they need for a seamless continuum of care.
https://t.co/1bsXOLCwur

Like @KCBSradio said, the Bueso family got the best Christmas present of all this year – the Senate passed the effort I authored along with @SenatorPadilla & @SenatorFeinstein to protect Isabel Bueso from deportation & loss of medical treatment she needs.
https://t.co/DEwcfB5FoP

Joined @DanAshleyABC7 to discuss our successful efforts this week to ensure Concord resident Isabel Bueso can remain in the U.S. and continue receiving lifesaving treatment for a rare disease following threat of deportation under the Trump Admin. https://t.co/UPAnb71r9o

Unions and the American workforce are the backbone of this nation. On #LaborDay, @HouseDemocrats continue to fight on behalf of all workers for fair pay and fair treatment. https://t.co/4Vht26C33x

Young people are at higher risk for sports-related concussions, which is why I’ve again introduced the Protecting Student Athletes from Concussions Act to ensure there are evidence-based treatment plans in place so that student athletes receive the support and care they need.

Today is #WorldMentalHealthDay, a great opportunity to check in on your friends, family, and yourself. Taking care of your mental health is an essential part of overall health and wellness. In Congress I’m working to increase access to mental health care and end the stigma. https://t.co/FY69YMGG7m
